item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 19/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Man-yi will move across the northern part of the South China Sea in the general direction of the vicinity south of Hainan Island and weaken gradually today and tomorrow. Under the combined effect of Man-yi and the northeast monsoon, it will be windy and rainy over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow. It will be appreciably cooler with swells. With Man-yi departing from the coastal areas and dissipating gradually, showers will ease off and it will become brighter over the region in the latter part of this week. Temperatures during the day will rise slightly. Another surge of a strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. It will be windy over the region.

Weather: It will be appreciably cooler. Cloudy with a few rain patches. Rain will be more frequent at times. There will be swells.
Temp range: 19 - 23 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
